shared_elements: human figure(s) with anatomical detail (arms/hands, hair or headgear)
incised linear detailing of drapery or garment
hand-held object held before the body
justification: Both are stone works bearing a frontal-torso arrangement of a figure with a prominent circular disc on the chest, incised horizontal bands and a decorated lower border, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a heavily eroded three-dimensional colossal statue whose ornament clings to a rounded body, while B is a flat, crisply cut low-relief panel with two profile figures in a legible facing encounter scene — completely different modes of carving, scale and pictorial intent.
